cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/workspace/tmp/dev/edges.py'
s=open(p).read()
start=s.index("    # atoms total across jobs")
end=s.index("    print('edges done')")
new = '''    # atoms total across jobs: 8 simple rules x 1000 atoms per job
    a_job = {'services': [{'name': 'A', 'label': 1}], 'limits': VALID['jobs'][0]['limits'],
             'events': [{'op': 'stage', 'epoch': epoch + 1,

    expect('too-many-stages-total', json.dumps({'jobs': [a_job] * 2}).encode(), {'error': 'invalid'})
    one_stage = {'services': [{'name': 'A', 'label': 1}], 'limits': VALID['jobs'][0]['limits'],
                 'events': [{'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1,
                             'policy': ''.join('match(A%d) allow;' % i for i in range(2000))}]}
    expect('atoms-16-stages', json.dumps({'jobs': [one_stage] * 4}).encode(),
           {'results': [{'events': [{'ok': True, 'epoch': 1,
                                     'image': {'accept': [False, True], 'rows': [[4294967295]]}}]}] * 4})
    expect('one-big-atom-job', json.dumps({'jobs': [{'services': [{'name': 'A', 'label': 1}],
                                                    'limits': VALID['jobs'][0]['limits'],
                                                    'events': [{'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1,
                                                                'policy': '(' + ' or '.join(['match(A)'] * 32769) + ') allow;'}]}]}).encode(),
           {'results': [{'events': [{'error': 'rejected'}]}]})
'''
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
